# Certified Payments

> Payment processing platform by Accelerated Card Company enabling secure credit card transactions and account management.

Certified Payments is a payment processing service operated by Accelerated Card Company, LLC, a registered ISO of Fifth Third Bank, National Association based in Cincinnati, OH. The platform provides tellers and account holders with tools for payment processing, account access, and secure credential management.

## Key Topics

- Payment Processing
- Credit Card Payments
- Certified Payments
- Accelerated Card Company
- Fifth Third Bank
- Account Access

- Password Management
